skills.description: This skill should be used when initializing AND incrementally maintaining a long-term LLM Wiki inside an Obsidian vault. Phase 1 scaffolds the raw/ (read-only source), wiki/ (AI-maintained knowledge layer) and Codex/ (cross-session memory) structure, plus AGENTS.md rules, index.md, log.md and four page templates (source/concept/entity/topic), with a vault-detection precondition check and the obsidian.json running-app pitfall. Phase 2 ingests newly added markdown from raw/ - searching existing pages first, creating source summaries, extracting concepts/entities/topics, merging into existing pages or creating new ones, preserving conflicting views with source/time/scope, wiring wikilinks, and updating index.md and log.md without ever modifying raw/. Use it whenever a user asks to build / set up / initialize an Obsidian wiki / knowledge base / second brain / zettelkasten, or to process / ingest / incrementally maintain new material into an existing wiki.
